dependency_security.blockingReason: 2026-10-30 integrated review-only PR #6 SHA dbbeb31921b47ea9a10a0cedde582c76ccfdb569 CI #41000449526 audit PASS at high threshold; 2 MODERATE advisories remain. This is verified same-SHA integrated code CI but no independent release-candidate/staging signoff. Commercial PR #4 SHA 7243563f CI #40998450262 audit FAIL with 65 advisories on old dependency graph.
dependency_security.unblockAction: Engineering review risk and disposition of 2 moderate advisories, preserve frozen-lockfile dependency graph, independently inspect integrated CI #41000449526 at its exact SHA, and repeat audit on final immutable release candidate if it changes. No downgrading audit threshold.

ci_build_tests.blockingReason: Integrated review-only PR #6 SHA dbbeb31921b47ea9a10a0cedde582c76ccfdb569 CI #41000449526 all four jobs PASS: 874 offline tests, 109 integration PASS/20 SKIP, 13 billing isolation PASS, real restricted-role PostgreSQL financial RLS, typecheck, API/web/Docker builds, high/critical audit PASS with 2 moderate. Branch failures must not be transferred to integrated green SHA, nor green result to new code.
ci_build_tests.unblockAction: Release owner independently review and pin a final immutable release candidate SHA, preserve this green integrated run as code evidence, rerun CI if any commit changes, and attach all nine gates' independent real provider/staging receipts on exactly that SHA. No merge/deploy.

tenant_rls.blockingReason: Integrated PR #6 SHA dbbeb31921b47ea9a10a0cedde582c76ccfdb569 CI #41000449526 PASS restricted-role financial PostgreSQL RLS across seven billing tables, two disposable CI tenants and no-tenant denial, plus 13 authenticated billing isolation tests. microsoft_per_user_oauth.blockingReason: No real Entra staging test-user consent/refresh/revoke or cross-user-denial artifact on candidate SHA; branch-local Microsoft CI assertions have failed.

stripe_test_billing.blockingReason: Integrated PR #6 CI #41000449526 is green, but its apps/web/src/app/api/billing/checkout/route.ts still only proxies invoiceId to /api/v1/subscription/billing/stripe/checkout (existing invoice payment), not first-customer recurring subscription checkout. frontend_customer_journeys.blockingReason: Integrated PR #6 SHA dbbeb31921b47ea9a10a0cedde582c76ccfdb569 CI #41000449526 passes 874/874 source tests and compiled web smoke, but Frontend PR #3 review (2026-10-30 05:19 UTC) identifies no public landing page or /signup route: root / is protected; invite acceptance/onboarding are not self-service signup. Frontend PR #3 newer SHA 3cac0194c1e536cc9712a379da5e3c02be6a26b6 is NOT integrated. Its CI #41007992793 failed audit (65 advisories: 2 critical, 25 high) and verify (8 Microsoft/finance integration failures) on its old dependency base. No interactive desktop/375px/Arabic RTL staging paid-customer browser UAT.
frontend_customer_journeys.unblockAction: Engineering/Commercial agree secure public plan discovery and signup/activation contract (tenant creation, verified identity, abuse/rate limits, no entitlement before signed Stripe webhook); Frontend implement public landing/pricing/signup/activation and accessible checkout/account/support states in its own files. Integrate latest frontend changes with audited Engineering base, rerun full CI on the new exact SHA, then record interactive desktop/375px Arabic RTL staging browser UAT and screenshots with reviewer.
